Build the per-compound tier-wise grouping recall table

build_compound_eval.Rd

For each compound instance × annotation tier, counts how many features were co-grouped with the [M+H]+ anchor (recall) versus split to a different pcgroup.

Usage

build_compound_eval(eval_full, anchors, purity)

Arguments

eval_full

data.frame. Output of build_eval_full.

anchors

data.frame. Output of build_anchors.

purity

list. Output of build_pcgroup_purity.

Value

A wide data.frame with one row per Lib_group, with columns n_MS1Match_<Tier>, n_CAMERA_grouped_<Tier>, n_CAMERA_split_<Tier> for each tier.
